comment: COMMENT 'STAKE' IF YOU'D JOIN THE HUNT

lines.text: London, 1970. Hundreds of people broke into a cemetery at night... carrying wooden stakes.
Highgate Cemetery. A grand Victorian graveyard that, by the late nineteen sixties, was overgrown and crumbling.
Then the stories started. A tall grey figure, seen drifting between the tombs.
The local paper began asking if something worse than a ghost was loose in Highgate.
Two rival occult investigators went on television. One said it wasn't a ghost at all. It was a vampire. And he announced a hunt.
Friday the 13th of March, 1970. The report aired that evening. By nightfall, crowds were climbing the walls with stakes and crosses. Police couldn't hold them back.
No vampire was ever found. But the legend never left. Today Highgate is restored, and open for tours.
Would you walk Highgate after dark? Comment stake... if you'd join the hunt.
